[for Robot 26] Validate replaces the metrics gate: give classes and modules the measures only the gate has, as graph facts with Clean Engineering code rules and limits (the person, 2026-11-24). Module: length (over 800 lines), maintainability index (below 20), average class complexity of its classes (over 15), fan-in (modules importing it, over 40), each a fact the module node holds, made from all its files. Shadow models stay a judged rule.
